title: Folder doc tab selection must match discovery's case-insensitivity
answers: Why does a README link to a doc with different capitalization open the wrong document?
Folder doc tab falls back to README even though the linked file exists
docTab URL param doesn't select the right tab when casing differs
Contributing.md link opens README instead of the Contributing tab
body:
Symptom: a folder README link (or shared URL) naming a doc with different capitalization than the actual file (e.g. `CONTRIBUTING.md` vs `contributing.md`) silently falls back to showing the README tab, with the intended tab present but unselected.
Root cause: FolderReadmePanel.tsx matched the `docTab` URL param against `doc.fileName` with a case-sensitive `===`, while doc discovery (which decides what counts as README/Contributing/Security) has always been case-insensitive — the two lookups were out of sync.
Fix pattern: lowercase both the user-supplied/URL-supplied name and the repo file name before comparing, mirroring the case-insensitivity already used at discovery time.
Constraints: applies to any matching of a user-authored or URL-carried file reference against real repo file names in this feature; does not apply to display — tab links must still render the file's real on-disk casing. A name genuinely absent from the folder should still fall back to the README.
applies: public/app/features/provisioning/components/Folders/FolderReadmePanel.tsx — matching docTab URL param to folder docs
